entries.tale.drowned_harbor.alpha3.briefing: Internal deterministic systems and replayability proof with placeholder presentation.

entries.ending.harbor_sealed: The harbor is sealed behind the final light.
entries.ending.last_lifeboat: The last lifeboat carries the attributed survivors away.
entries.ending.light_comes_home: The light returns with every name it can carry.
